item.title: Challenge links look like the app
item.summary: Opening a challenge link without Murph now shows the same invite card as the app: both tasks, when the game runs, and the prize or dare on its ticket, with one Get the app button.
item.details: If the game needs a photo or heart rate from a wearable, the page says so before you accept. A link that no longer works now says why: already accepted, ran out, or called off.
